question: The first Khelo India University Games were hosted in ______ at ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2020; Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• After the resounding success of the Khelo India School Games in 2018 and the Youth Games in 2019 and 2020, for the very first time, the Khelo India University Games were held in 2020 in Odisha.
 
• It was held at the Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology, Odisha.
 
• This was the largest-ever competition held at the university level in India.
 
• There were a total of 17 sports being held in 11 venues in Bhubaneswar and Cuttack.
 
• It is organized by the **Sports Authority of India (SAI) and the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports along with the Association of Indian Universities, the Indian Olympic Association, and the National Sports Federation. **
 
• It is the largest university-level sports competition in India.
 
• The winner of the Khelo India University Games 2020 was Punjab University while Savitribai Phule Pune University was the runner-up.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The second edition of Khelo India University Games 2021** was held in **Bengaluru **from** April 24 to May 3, 2022**.
 
• The hosts Jain University won the Khelo India University Games 20211 title with 20 gold medals. They also won seven silvers and five bronze, taking their overall medal tally to 32.
